name: danvas
help:
Unified Canvas operations CLI.

Use this for day-to-day course work: discover courses, export rosters, create or audit assignments, move submission files, post grades, and score discussions. Canvas-changing commands plan by default and require --apply. It intentionally does not manage archival ledger/history data.
